videos.name: Inside the Mighty Nein: Premiere Cocktail Party
videos.overview: The Mighty Nein animated series is finally here! Join us LIVE for a night of celebration as the cast and crew of The Mighty Nein reunite to chat about the making of the show and take questions from the Beacon Discord!

videos.name: Inside The Mighty Nein - Episodes 1-5
videos.overview: Join the cast of The Mighty Nein as they dive into episodes 1-5 of the premiere season! Show creators Matthew Mercer, Marisha Ray, Sam Riegel, Taliesin Jaffe, Travis Willingham, and Liam O’Brien sit down with showrunner Tasha Huo and voice of The Ruby of the Sea, Anika Noni Rose, to discuss the making of the show.

videos.overview:

videos.name: Inside The Mighty Nein - Episodes 6-8
videos.overview: The cast of The Mighty Nein is back, this time with behind the scenes details on the final three episodes of the premiere season! Show creators Matthew Mercer, Marisha Ray, Sam Riegel, Laura Bailey, Travis Willingham, and Ashley Johnson are joined by Prop & FX Design Supervisor, Dennis Fries and voice of Verrat, Rahul Kohli for a deep dive into the show's creation.

videos.name: Who Will You Be?
videos.overview: After surviving a shipwreck, Fjord Stone discovers he suddenly has magical powers. In Nicodranas, Jester Lavorre's phallic pranks get her in trouble. Meanwhile, Nott's sticky fingers nearly get her and Caleb killed, as Beau's investigation heads South.

videos.name: The Fletching & Moondrop Traveling Carnival of Curiosities
videos.overview: Mollymauk Tealeaf introduces a dangerous new act to attract customers to his failing carnival. Amidst the attractions, Beau meets her clandestine informant, Jester shows Fjord how to have fun, and Caleb and Nott try to steal a rare magical component.

videos.name: The Mighty Nein
videos.overview: Framed for the carnival massacre, the Mighty Nein must come together to rescue a young girl and clear their names - if they don't kill each other first. Meanwhile, Essek and Trent Ikithon begin their Beacon experiments. Trent is thrilled by the implications, leaving Essek to reconsider his choices.

videos.name: Little Spark
videos.overview: After the Mighty Nein break out of prison and subdue a Volstrucker assassin, Beau interrogates her brutally. But as the questioning ramps up, Beau's suspicions turn to to Caleb as his connection with the Empire and dark past are unraveled.

videos.name: Many Gifts
videos.overview: The Mighty Nein seek out a notorious smuggler in Zadash called "The Gentleman", who can provide them with protection against Volstrucker assassins – on one condition. They must procure an ancient treasure for him. But they must learn to work together or face deadly consequences.

videos.name: Belonging
videos.overview: After the Mighty Nein prove their worth, The Gentleman offers another assignment – to steal a mysterious Kryn artifact. Competing desires, however, lead the Nein on separate journeys throughout Zadash. While in the Dynasty, Essek betrays Verrat after a devastating loss.

videos.name: The Zadash Job
videos.overview: After the Mighty Nein reunite, they embark on an elaborate heist to steal the mysterious Kryn artifact for The Gentleman. But when their plan completely falls apart, it's unclear how the Nein will even escape with their lives.
